name: Dune Swallower
text: Keywords: SpellShield, Fearsome. To play me, kill an ally or one of your mana gems 3 times.

name: Ottrani Dragon-Worshiper
text: When I'm summoned, heal your Nexus 2 and gain an extra mana gem next round.

name: Scholarly Pioneer
text: Keywords: Challenger. Play: Pick an Explorer spell to create in hand.

name: The Kingfisher
text: When I'm summoned, draw 1 of each champion from your deck. Each round, the first time you summon a champion, Rally.

name: Alatis the Gallant
text: Keywords: Fury. Your Dragon Boons target all Dragon allies.

name: Capsize
text: Recall an enemy to increase the cost of the next unit your opponent plays this round by 2.

name: Portal Pioneer
text: Keywords: Attune. Play: Pick an Explorer spell to create in hand.

name: The Beautiful Disaster
text: Keywords: Landmark. I: Kill a unit with total Power and Health 5 or less. II: Drain the enemy Nexus 2. III: Summon an exact copy of an ally. It's Ephemeral and 1|1.

name: Lux: Illuminated
text: Keywords: Spirit, Support. Support: Grant my supported ally Spirit and give me Barrier this round. Level up: Allies have attacked with or have gained while attacking 20+ total positive keywords.

name: Dreamlight Alina
text: Keywords: Spirit. When I'm summoned, summon 5 Spritelings. For each one there isn't space for, grant the Weakest ally 2 Spirit instead.

name: Luminosprite
text: Keywords: Support. Support: Give my supported ally all of my positive keywords and their stacks this round.

name: Empire Reconstructor
text: Play: Grant an allied landmark, "When I'm destroyed, revive me."

name: Soaring Cartographer
text: Keywords: Brash. Play: Updraft 1 to draw another card that costs either more or less than the card you Updrafted.

name: Steel Gale
text: Stun an enemy and Stun it again at the next Round Start.

name: The Poro Parade
text: Keywords: Landmark. I-II: Manifest a follower that has a different subtype than allies in play. III: Give an ally +1|+1 this round for each ally with a subtype.

name: Brynhir Thundersong
text: Play: Obliterate a unit in hand to summon a Stormcarved Spire that has Countdown equal to its cost and summons an exact copy of the unit. (minimum 1)

name: Ultrasoft Poro
text: Play: Heal your Nexus 1 for each ally with a subtype.

name: Uncle Milty
text: Keywords: Impact. Grant me 2 Spirit once you've completed a Story.

name: The Wingsgiving
text: Keywords: Landmark. I-II: Pick an ally, then pick 1 of 3 followers that costs 1 more to transform it into. III: Pick an ally, then pick 1 of 3 followers that costs 2 more to transform it into.

name: The Pit Champion
text: Keywords: Landmark. I: An ally and an enemy Strike each other. They can't drop below 1 Health from this Strike. II: Fully heal an ally. III: Create 3 Coins in hand.

name: Mercenary Manners
text: Steal an enemy follower with 3 or less Health this round. (Can't play if you have 6 allies or landmarks already.)

name: Zed (level 2)
text: Keywords: Quick Attack. Attack: Summon an attacking Living Shadow with my stats and positive keywords.

name: Shen (level 2)
text: Keywords: Barrier, Support. Support: Give my supported ally Barrier this round. When an ally gets Barrier, give it +3|+0 this round.

name: Vladimir (level 2)
text: Keywords: Fearsome, Regeneration. Play: Deal 1 to any number of allies to deal that much to an enemy. Attack: For each attacking ally on my right, deal 1 to it and drain 1 from the enemy Nexus.

name: Jinx (level 2)
text: Keywords: Quick Attack. Round Start: Draw 1. Each round, the first time I level up or you empty your hand, create a Super Mega Death Rocket! in hand.

name: Teemo (level 2)
text: Keywords: Elusive. Nexus Strike: Double the Poison Puffcaps in the enemy deck (plants 5 minimum).

name: Hecarim (level 2)
text: Keywords: Overwhelm. When I level up, grant your Nexus "Ephemeral allies have +3|+0". Attack: Summon 2 attacking Spectral Riders.

name: Kalista (level 2)
text: Keywords: Fearsome. Each round, the first time I attack revive an attacking Ephemeral copy of the strongest dead allied follower. This round, we're bonded and it takes damage for me.

name: Thresh (level 2)
text: Keywords: Challenger. The first time I attack this game, summon another attacking champion from your deck or hand.

name: Fizz (level 2)
text: Keywords: Imbue. When you play a spell, stop all enemy spells and Skills targeting me and give me Elusive this round. Nexus Strike: Create a Chum the Waters in hand.

name: Twisted Fate (level 2)
text: Keywords: Quick Attack. Each round, the first 3 times you play a card, I play a Destiny Card.

name: Maokai (level 2)
text: Keywords: Regeneration. When I level up, Obliterate the enemy deck, leaving 4 non-champions. Round Start: Summon a Sapling.

name: Lee Sin (level 2)
text: Keywords: Imbue. When you play a spell, give me Challenger this round. If you play another, give me Barrier this round. I Dragon's Rage enemies that I Challenge.

name: Riven (level 2)
text: When I'm summoned, if you have the attack token, or when you gain the attack token, Reforge. Each round, the first time you increase my Power, grant me that much Power.

name: Zoe (level 2)
text: Keywords: Elusive, Missing Translation. When I level up, grant your Nexus "When you summon an ally, grant its keywords to all allies." Nexus Strike: Create a Behold the Infinite that costs 0 in hand.

name: Pyke (level 2)
text: Keywords: Lurk, Quick Attack. When I Lurk, transform me into Death From Below. When I kill an enemy, I strike the weakest enemy.

name: Rek'Sai (level 2)
text: Keywords: Lurk, Overwhelm. When I level up, create 3 random Lurkers in hand. When I Lurk or Attack: Grant Lurker allies everywhere +1|+0.

name: Zilean (level 2)
text: Round Start: Create a Fleeting copy of each non-Fleeting card I saw you play last round. Play: Create 4 Time Bombs in your deck, then Predict.

name: Azir (level 2)
text: When I level up, replace your deck with the Emperor's Deck, then draw 1. When allies attack, summon an attacking Sandstone Charger.

name: Sivir (level 2)
text: Keywords: Quick Attack, SpellShield. While I'm attacking, attacking allies have my keywords.

name: LeBlanc (level 2)
text: Keywords: Quick Attack. Each time you deal 15+ damage, create a Mirror Image in hand. If you already have one, reduce its cost by 1 instead.

name: Viego (level 2)
text: Keywords: Fearsome. Each round, the first time another unit dies, summon an Encroaching Mist. Round Start: Steal the strongest enemy this round. If it's a champion, kill it instead.

name: Jarvan IV (level 2)
text: Keywords: Barrier. When you attack, pay my cost to summon me Challenging the strongest enemy. Round Start: Create a Fleeting Cataclysm in hand. When I Challenge an enemy, give me Barrier this round.

name: Tristana (level 2)
text: Keywords: Quick Attack, Impact. I have +1|+0 for each multi-region ally you've summoned this game. When you summon a multi-region ally, grant me and it +1|+0 and Impact.

name: Poppy (level 2)
text: Keywords: Impact. Attack: Grant allies with equal or less power than me +2|+2 and Impact.

name: Nami (level 2)
text: Keywords: Attune, Imbue. When you play a spell, grant +2|+1 to the weakest other ally that isn't Immobile.

name: Senna (level 2)
text: Keywords: Quick Attack, Missing Translation. When I'm summoned or Attack: Create a Darkness in hand if you don't have one. Your damage and kill spells accelerate to Fast and cost 1 less.

name: Pantheon (level 2)
text: Keywords: Overwhelm, Barrier. Once a Pantheon has leveled up, grant me a random keyword for each round you've targeted allies this game.

name: Galio (level 2)
text: Keywords: Formidable, SpellShield. When I'm summoned, grant other allies +0|+3. Each round, the first time an ally takes damage, Rally.

name: Kai'Sa (level 2)
text: Keywords: Evolve. When I'm summoned or Round Start: If you have the attack token, create a Second Skin in hand. Attack: Deal 1 for each positive keyword I have to enemies or the enemy Nexus (lowest health first).

name: Gwen (level 2)
text: Keywords: Hallowed, Quick Attack. Attack: When another ally gains Power from Hallowed, so do I. Drain 1 from the enemy Nexus one time for every 2 Power I have.
